blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philreca party-list Rep. Presley de Jesus on Wednesday criticized the proposed low budget allocation for training and taking care of Narcotic Detection Dogs or K-9s for illegal drug operations across the country for 2027, emphasizing that their roles in illegal drug seizures are too important to be allocated such an amount.
